description.html: The HabiStat Double Feeding Ledge is an upgraded version of the popular HabiStat feeding ledge, equipped with two clear cups so you can offer food and water to your arboreal reptiles at the same time. Made from quality black acrylic, this double ledge attaches securely to the glass walls of the terrarium with suction cups, with no need for glue or permanent modifications.

Its 160x60x80mm dimensions provide enough space for two removable clear cups, one of which can be used for food (fruit mash, insect powder) and the other for fresh water. This is especially practical because it removes the need for two separate feeding and drinking spots, saving space in the terrarium. The clear cups let you see the contents from every angle, so you can easily track how much your reptile eats.

The cups detach easily from the platform for quick cleaning and refilling, which makes daily maintenance much easier. This model is ideal for crested geckos, day geckos, anoles and other arboreal species that feed in elevated positions in the wild. By mounting the ledge at the right height in the terrarium, you simulate natural feeding behavior, which reduces stress and encourages activity in your animals.
HabiStat is a renowned British brand with many years of experience producing reptile equipment, known for the quality of its materials and the practical design of its products.
